why: The topics written before research-first became the rule, whose research is still to come. Every other artifact in this cookbook is written from its research, kept in its research/ folder (see guide/introduction/conventions.md, Research). A topic leaves this list in the commit that adds its research/ folder (/grow-cookbook, stage 2), and nothing joins it: a topic written now brings its research. cookr validate refuses a listed topic that has research/, that is no artifact, or that is listed twice.
